subject: Correct README to ungated/shadow-gate framing (drop stale "abstain-by-default")
description:
The public README.md carries the SUPERSEDED "abstain-by-default gate" framing that the 2026-06-12 decision (note-mqatnwimnk0) reversed. Production retrieval is now UNGATED (always-inject default); the context gate runs only as a SHADOW scorer; the LEARNED CONDITIONAL inject policy is the roadmap. The README must stop implying a live abstaining filter.

Files (zonoid repo): README.md, and check bench/heldout/specs/readme-positioning.md + packages/cli/README.md for the same stale phrasing.

Stale lines in README.md to fix:
- L3 hero: "...when memory actually pays."
- L11-12: "...the context gate abstains when retrieval wouldn't pay."
- L30: "context gate that abstains when retrieval wouldn't pay"

Correct framing (align to note-mqatnwimnk0 + E1 guardrail in business/competitive/E1-launch-messaging.md):
- Production = context flows by default (always-inject); the agent gets relevant DAG+RAG context, NOT a live abstain filter.
- A SHADOW gate computes "would retrieval have helped" on every search (journaled) — this is measurement, not enforcement.
- The LEARNED conditional inject policy — p(inject helps | task, note, KB state) — is the ROADMAP/direction, not a shipped feature.
- HARD CONSTRAINT: do NOT claim "gated retrieval is live" or that the gate "abstains" in production. "Retrieve only when it helps" may appear as the ASPIRATION/direction, not as current behavior.
- Keep the surviving receipts unchanged: cold 0/8 → warm 8/8 held-out; do NOT introduce retracted multipliers.

Keep edits surgical and on-message — rephrase the gate sentences only; do not rewrite the whole README. Preserve tone/structure. After editing, grep README.md for "abstain" and confirm no remaining present-tense live-abstention claim.

summary: Applied 4 surgical README edits on branch orch/attempt/9ac28409-89f3-4bb5-bc12-c2e78830cbab-2 (commit 35be44f): (1) hero line: added 'is learning'; (2) context-retrieval paragraph: shadow gate measures on every search; (3) Token-aware bullet: shadow gate scoring toward learned inject policy; (4) ASCII diagram box: shadow gate replaces context gate. git grep -n abstain README.md → 0 matches. Not pushed — branch left for review/merge.
